views.name: problem_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  name,
  path,
  type,
  target
FROM problem
views.description: Normalized problem rows: canonical pass-through of problem attributes. Use when joining problem metadata to other tables or selecting dataset-level attributes. | Use for: list datasets and their metadata; join dataset metadata to scores or features; filter problems by type or target

views.name: eda_feature_rows
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  name,
  version,
  feature,
  type,
  range,
  drop_user,
  drop_correlation,
  target
FROM eda
views.description: One row per (name, version, feature) describing per-feature EDA attributes and drop flags. Use to inspect feature-level decisions and join to feature importance or solutions. | Use for: which features were dropped by user or correlation; compare feature types or ranges across versions; join feature metadata to importances

views.name: feature_importance_rows
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  name,
  version,
  step,
  feature,
  importance
FROM feature_importance
views.description: Raw feature importance measurements at (name, version, step, feature). Use as the base for aggregations or joins to eda/solution. | Use for: aggregate importance by feature or version; join with eda to filter dropped features; trace importance evolution across steps

views.name: model_score_rows
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  name,
  version,
  step,
  model,
  train_score,
  test_score
FROM model_score
views.description: Model-level train/test scores per (name, version, step, model). Use as base for comparing models, computing deltas, or joining model attributes. | Use for: compare train vs test performance; select best model per version/step; trend of model performance across steps

views.name: model_importance_rows
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  name,
  version,
  step,
  model,
  importance
FROM model_importance
views.description: Model-level importance/weight per (name, version, step, model). Use to inspect model contributions or join to scores. | Use for: assess model weights in ensembles; join to model_score to explain performance

views.name: solution_rows
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  name,
  version,
  correlation,
  nb_model,
  nb_feature,
  score,
  test_size,
  resampling
FROM solution
views.description: One row per (name, version) summarizing a candidate solution. Use for dataset-version level analysis and joins to feature/model artifacts. | Use for: rank or compare solutions for a dataset; join solution summary to feature or model-level tables

views.name: model_rows
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  name,
  version,
  step,
  L1_model
FROM model
views.description: One row per (name, version, step) exposing the L1_model label. Use to bring model metadata into score/importance analyses. | Use for: map scores or importances to model family/type; filter analyses to specific model families

views.name: best_model_per_version_step
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  ms.name,
  ms.version,
  ms.step,
  ms.model,
  ms.train_score,
  ms.test_score
FROM (
  SELECT
    name,
    version,
    step,
    model,
    train_score,
    test_score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY name, version, step ORDER BY COALESCE(test_score, -1) DESC, COALESCE(train_score, -1) DESC) AS rn
  FROM model_score
) ms
WHERE ms.rn = 1
views.description: Within each (name, version, step) rank models by test_score descending and expose the top-ranked model row. Use to select the best-performing model per step/version. | Use for: identify top model per step/version; compare best model performance across versions

views.name: latest_version_per_problem
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  name,
  MAX(version) AS version
FROM solution
GROUP BY name
views.description: Select the latest version number per problem.name. Useful to focus analyses on the most recent solution/version. | Use for: restrict analyses to most recent solution versions; join most-recent version to feature/model artifacts

views.name: solution_with_problem
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.name,
  s.version,
  s.correlation,
  s.nb_model,
  s.nb_feature,
  s.score,
  s.test_size,
  s.resampling,
  p.path,
  p.type,
  p.target
FROM solution s
LEFT JOIN problem p
  ON s.name = p.name
views.description: Denormalized solution rows joined to problem metadata (one row per solution (name,version) with dataset attributes). Use to present solution summaries with dataset context. | Use for: display solution metrics alongside dataset info; filter solutions by dataset type or target

views.name: model_score_with_modelmeta
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  ms.name,
  ms.version,
  ms.step,
  ms.model,
  ms.train_score,
  ms.test_score,
  m.L1_model
FROM model_score ms
LEFT JOIN model m
  ON ms.name = m.name
  AND ms.version = m.version
  AND ms.step = m.step
views.description: Model scores joined to model metadata (L1_model) at matching (name, version, step). One row per model score with its model family/type. | Use for: compare performance by L1_model family; filter scores to a particular L1_model type

views.name: feature_importance_aggregated_by_feature
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  name,
  version,
  feature,
  SUM(COALESCE(importance, 0)) AS importance
FROM feature_importance
GROUP BY name, version, feature
views.description: Aggregate feature importance per (name, version, feature) by summing importance across steps. Use to get a stable per-version importance score for each feature. | Use for: rank features by total importance per version; join aggregated importances to eda to check dropped features

views.name: model_performance_summary
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  name,
  version,
  model,
  COUNT(*) AS step_count,
  AVG(test_score) AS avg_test_score,
  MAX(test_score) AS max_test_score
FROM model_score
GROUP BY name, version, model
views.description: Summary statistics of model test_score per (name, version, model): count of steps, avg and max test_score. Use to compare stability and peak performance of models across steps. | Use for: identify most stable models (by step_count or avg score); compare peak model performance across versions

views.name: features_with_dropped_flag
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  e.name,
  e.version,
  e.feature,
  e.type,
  e.range,
  e.drop_user,
  e.drop_correlation,
  e.target
FROM eda e
views.description: Features annotated with their EDA drop flags: one row per (name, version, feature) combining EDA flags. Use to filter out features that were marked for dropping by user or correlation when joining to importances. | Use for: remove dropped features before aggregating importances; report which important features were dropped by EDA
